This matter is taken up through hybrid arrangement (virtual/physical) mode.

2. The Petitioner, by filing this Writ Petition has invoked the jurisdiction of this Court under Article 226 of the Constitution, seeking the prayer to direct the Opposite Party No.2 & 3 to pay compensation of Rs.37,98,071/- towards acquisition of his land for construction of Lower Indra Irrigation Project, Khariar.

3. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned Additional Standing Counsel.
4.

Keeping in view the submissions made and on going through the averments taken in the Petition as well as the documents annexed thereto; it is seen that the Petitioner had moved the Competent Authority under section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short, 'the LA Act').
The Competent Authority in that proceeding appears to have re-determined the compensation not only in respect of the land of the Petitioner, which had been acquired but also for the trees.

It has also awarded the interest from the date as has been awarded in favour of the person, who was pursuing the reference under section 18 of the L.A Act and basing on whose award, the Petitioner had sought for re- // 2 // determination of the compensation even though, the Petitioner had not moved for any reference and was silent.

5. Learned counsel for the State submits that in the situation as aforesaid, it would be ideal if the Petitioner moves the Collector, Nuapada by filing an application for redressal of his grievances and he would then do further needful.

sentences.text: 1 In view of the submission as above, without expressing any opinion on the merit of the claim of the Petitioner, the present application stands disposed of granting liberty to the Petitioner to file an application before the Collector, Nuapada within two weeks hence narrating all his grievances for their redressal and in that event, the Collector would do well to consider the same on its own merit and dispose of it in accordance with law within a period of three weeks from the date of receipt of the application and intimate the result thereof to the Petitioner within a week thereafter.
Issue urgent certified copy of this order as per rules.
